text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past interactions as continuing demand for broadly related items, with insufficient attention to the specific purpose behind a user's next choice.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they connect recent interests to specific artists, musical qualities, or story themes.",
    "Recommendations align when complementary supplies or devices support an established task or add a useful capability to existing equipment."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related products compete with more relevant choices despite requiring unsupported projects, device ownership, or compatibility assumptions.",
    "Similar purchases are treated as continued demand even when they duplicate an existing capability or exceed the user's practical needs.",
    "Older or seasonal interactions appear to carry continuing influence when recent behavior suggests a narrower or different interest."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Shared category, brand, ecosystem, era, or collection format substitutes for a specific reason to choose an item.",
    "A past interaction is treated as evidence of enduring enthusiasm or immediate demand for related purchases."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent, specific connections in artist, sound, story, or practical task matter more than broad similarity.",
    "Connector type, dimensions, materials, quantity, and equipment requirements determine whether an otherwise related product is usable.",
    "Users distinguish useful additions from redundant purchases and distinguish general interest from a reason to choose something now."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top-ranked items too often share a broad association with past activity without providing a specific, timely, and practically supported reason for the user to choose them.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "Track the proportion of top-ranked recommendations users would choose now, separating definite choices from general interest.",
    "Track rejection reasons involving incompatible specifications, unsupported prerequisites, redundant functions, or excessive quantity.",
    "Track whether recommendations tied to recent specific interests receive stronger choice intent than those tied only to broad categories or older seasonal activity."
  ]
}
